legal.onboarding.title: Review how Rion Studio works
legal.onboarding.description: Rion Studio stores browser roles locally, operates third-party pages, and provides supervised macros and optional network compatibility features. Review these disclosures before using the app.
legal.onboarding.independentDescription: Not affiliated with or endorsed by any game, Google, Chrome, Facebook, or identity provider. You must follow each service's rules.
legal.onboarding.sessionDescription: Role profiles can contain cookies and authentication tokens. Passwords are not intentionally stored, but anyone with device access may be able to use a saved session.
legal.onboarding.networkDescription: Updates use GitHub. CDN Auto can test Google access and route supported resources to mirrors. A custom proxy can process browser traffic.
legal.onboarding.acceptTerms: I have read and agree to the Terms of Use and Fair Use Rules.
legal.onboarding.acknowledgePrivacy: I have read and acknowledge the Privacy Notice, including local session, update, CDN, proxy, and export disclosures.
legal.onboarding.error: Rion Studio could not save or load the legal acceptance record. Try again or quit the app.
